title: Extremely disappointed about new update
body:
Hello Hitwicket Team,

I have been playing Hitwicket for a long time and have invested hundreds of hours into building my team. I have always supported the game and even took the time to send detailed suggestions because I genuinely wanted it to improve.

Unfortunately, after the recent updates, I feel like the game has become unfair rather than more balanced.

Here are my biggest concerns:

1. The game no longer feels skill-based. Many matches feel predetermined instead of rewarding good strategy and team building.
2. Shot percentages seem meaningless. My World Class batters like Gill have over 80% shot probability, yet they frequently fail to connect. Meanwhile, opponents with much weaker batters and shot power below 60% confidently hit boundaries against bowlers like Rabada. This makes player stats feel unreliable.
3. Progression has become frustrating. I worked hard to reach Legendary and Supreme levels, but after the update my reputation dropped back to Masterful. It feels like months of progress were taken away overnight.
4. Player balancing feels unfair. Even the base power of my strongest players, including Gill and Hussey, has been reduced. Instead of rewarding long-term players, the update makes our teams feel weaker.
5. The game increasingly feels pay-to-win. I understand premium purchases should offer convenience, but they should not make free-to-play players feel like they can never compete fairly. Right now, it feels as though paying players receive a significant gameplay advantage rather than just faster progression.

I don’t mind losing matches. I have accepted defeats many times when I felt the better team or better strategy won.

What I cannot accept is feeling that my decisions, upgrades, and months of progression matter less than hidden balancing changes.

This is genuinely disappointing because I enjoyed building my franchise and recommending this game to others.

Unless these issues are addressed and the game becomes more transparent and balanced, I have decided to stop playing.

I hope the team seriously considers the concerns of long-term players because a fair and rewarding experience is what keeps a community alive.

Thank you.

I have been playing Hitwicket since 2024. I spent thousands of rupees on this game, including purchasing the ₹1000 Season Pass every month, and spent years building my team one player at a time.

Sadly, I regret every rupee I spent.

Ranked matchmaking is terrible. My Level 85–89 team is constantly matched against Level 100 teams, making months of hard work meaningless.

The game is also full of technical problems:

Server disconnects during matches.

Random freezing.

Mobile overheating.

Poor optimization.

Even 90% chance shots miss at crucial moments, making the gameplay feel frustrating instead of rewarding.


Every month, new players with overpowered traits are released for ₹3,000, ₹5,000, ₹10,000, and even ₹15,000. Instead of fixing the game's major issues, it feels like the developers have become more focused on monetization than on improving the player experience.

In my experience, if you don't keep spending money, progression becomes painfully slow and it's difficult to play more than a handful of meaningful matches each day.

I have cancelled my subscription and requested that my account be permanently deleted.

Warning to new players: Read the recent reviews carefully before downloading this game or spending any money. There are many games that provide a fairer experience and better value. I wish I had known this before investing my time and money.

title: The game has completely lost its balance
body:
The biggest problem with Hitwicket right now is the complete lack of balance and competitiveness between bat and ball.
How is it acceptable that 2-star or 3-star opposition players consistently outperform 4-star and 5-star players, even when you’re batting sensibly, building an innings, and avoiding blind slogging? It makes player progression and team-building feel almost meaningless.
What’s even more frustrating is the team composition. How can you allow Snap and Hex in the same team and call it “balanced”? Or let bowling lineups stack 3–4 Hex players and still claim there’s a fair contest between bat and ball? It completely destroys competitive integrity.
I’ve played over 4,000 matches, so this isn’t a knee-jerk reaction after a few unlucky games. I’ve invested a huge amount of time into this game because I genuinely enjoyed it. But instead of improving, the balancing decisions have become increasingly frustrating.
I’m honestly irritated by these fundamental design choices. It feels like skill, strategy, and careful gameplay matter far less than arbitrary balancing decisions.

This is the point where I walk away. I quit.

Hi,

The game and gameplay are exceptionally good and fun, but the stats and score-recording bugs are seriously spoiling the experience.

Earlier, the half-century and century count was wrong. Now, those features seem to be gone, and even the runs scored in previous matches are showing incorrect values or not getting saved properly. What is the point of having these features if the data is wrong?

The Man of the Match selection in PvP also feels broken. If the user bats last, a batsman usually gets the award. But when the user is bowling, even if a batsman contributes more, they still don’t seem to get Man of the Match.

Honestly, you have built a splendid game, but silly bugs like this slipping through QA really hurts the full gameplay experience. For now, I’m giving 1 star because these issues are frustrating.
